title: Battle of Werbach
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Werbach", at revision 1372784867, opens: "The Battle of Werbach took place during the Austro-Prussian War as part of the Campaign of the Main on 24 July 1866 between the Prussian Alliance and the German Federal Army." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q15811479, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1866 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
